story_info.title: Luna Owl and the Library Letters

main_character.name: Luna Owl

supporting_characters.name: Pip Squirrel
supporting_characters.appearance: A tiny, fluffy brown squirrel with a bushy tail and bright, quick eyes. He always carries a small nut.

slides.title: A Puzzled Friend
slides.text: Luna Owl loved the Old Oak Library. It was a calm place with tall shelves. One sunny afternoon, she saw Pip Squirrel. Pip had a bushy tail and bright, quick eyes. He was looking at something dusty. Pip looked very puzzled. Luna flew closer. "Hello, Pip," she said gently. Her curiosity started to grow.
slides.speaker_notes: Luna Owl discovers her friend Pip Squirrel looking puzzled in the library.

slides.title: Secret Squiggles
slides.text: Pip held an old, crinkly page. It was yellow and soft. On the page were many tiny squiggles. "Luna," Pip squeaked, "what are these funny lines? Are they secret drawings?" Luna looked closely. The squiggles looked like small hooks and circles. She had never seen them quite like this before. It was a little puzzle.
slides.speaker_notes: Pip shows Luna an old page with strange squiggles, making Luna curious.

slides.title: What Are Letters?
slides.text: Luna tilted her head. Then she remembered a very old scroll! "Pip," she said, "these are not drawings. These are letters! Letters are like special shapes. They help us make sounds." Luna pointed to a curvy shape. "This is letter 'S'. It makes a 'ssss' sound, like a snake!" Pip's eyes grew wide.
slides.speaker_notes: Luna explains that the squiggles are letters and what they do.

slides.title: Letters Make Words
slides.text: "And when letters stand together, they make words!" Luna showed him. She pointed to three letters: 'S', 'U', 'N'. "See? S-U-N spells SUN! We see the sun every day!" Pip tried to make the sounds. He felt very clever. "Wow!" he squeaked. Luna smiled. "Every question opens a new adventure!" she said softly.
slides.speaker_notes: Luna teaches Pip how letters combine to form words.

slides.title: A Wonderful Discovery
slides.text: Luna and Pip looked at more pages. They found letters for 'tree' and 'leaf'. Learning letters felt like a fun game. Pip felt happy. He found a new way to understand books. Luna felt warm in her heart. She loved helping her friend discover something new. The library felt even more wonderful.
slides.speaker_notes: Luna and Pip share a happy moment of learning and friendship in the library.
